description.en: Tasks from the auditory exercises: draw the use case diagram, then check it against the model solution.

question.en: Draw a use case diagram for a restaurant. There are several types of employees in the restaurant: waiter, chef and restaurant manager, who log into the system with their IDs. The restaurant offers various specialties made from several products. The stocks of products are stored in a warehouse. The chef of the restaurant is making plans for new specialties that will be found on the menu. For this purpose, a supply list is generated and it is used to order products from a supplier. Upon receipt of products ordered by a supplier, the product data should be updated in the warehouse. Customers make orders where they specify the menu specialties and their quantity. The waiter needs to enter the order and the table number in the system. After that, the chef receives information on his computer for the recipes he should prepare. After the meal preparation, he activates a command to update the status of products in the warehouse, and the system sends a message to the waiter that the specialties are ready and they can be served to the guests. Once the clients have completed the meal, they call the waiter who needs to close the bill for the specified table and to activate the print command in order the print the receipt. Customers can pay the bill in cash or with a credit card.

question.en: Draw a use case diagram that describes the functionalities of a library. Librarians who work in the library are responsible for entering data for new books and magazines. Librarians need to prepare different reports at different times of the year. Every six months they have to make a report for the total number of newly purchased samples in the last six months. At the end of the year, they should make a list of all the books and magazines purchased in the current year. Also, at the end of the year they should make a report including all members who are late with the return of borrowed samples for more than a month. Members can search the book fund through the terminals that are placed in the library (by entering the author's data or the book/magazine title). If members want to borrow a book/magazine, they should go to the appropriate rental point and tell the number of the book or magazine they want to rent. If the member is not registered in the system, the librarian should request personal information, and register him/her in the system.

After the search, users get a list of plays and by selecting one of them, the system displays detailed information about it. On this screen, there is a booking button. When this button is clicked, user can fill a booking form, and after the successful check for free seats, information about the successful/unsuccessful ticket reservation is printed. If the booking is successful, then the user can print a booking confirmation necessary for the purchase of tickets.
